description: Personal communication, scheduling, and coursework: searching and reading Gmail, creating/updating Google Calendar events, and inspecting Google Classroom courses, assignments, and announcements.
routing_rules: Assign for all email (Gmail) inquiries, calendar events, meeting scheduling, personal agendas, and Google Classroom coursework or announcements.

tools.name: google_auth_login
tools.description: Initiates Google Workspace OAuth flow, starts local callback receiver, and prints the direct authorization link to terminal.

tools.name: gmail_list
tools.description: Lists recent emails matching query via Google Workspace OAuth client.

tools.name: gmail_read
tools.description: Fetches full content, headers, subject, and body for a specific email message ID.

tools.name: gmail_check_unread
tools.description: Quick scan of unread inbox emails across one or all configured accounts.

tools.name: gmail_send_draft
tools.description: Creates a new email draft in Gmail without sending it immediately.

tools.name: gmail_reply
tools.description: Creates a draft reply to an existing email thread preserving subject and message references.

tools.name: gmail_send
tools.description: Dispatches an email immediately to recipient addresses.

tools.name: calendar_list
tools.description: Lists upcoming events and meetings from Google Calendar within a time window.

tools.name: calendar_create_event
tools.description: Creates a new event or appointment on Google Calendar.

tools.name: calendar_edit_event
tools.description: Modifies start/end time, summary, description, or attendees of an existing calendar event.

tools.name: calendar_delete_event
tools.description: Deletes or cancels an existing event on Google Calendar.

tools.name: tasks_list
tools.description: Lists pending tasks and to-do items from Google Tasks.

tools.name: tasks_create
tools.description: Creates a new to-do task item in Google Tasks.

tools.name: classroom_list_courses
tools.description: Lists active Google Classroom courses enrolled in or taught.

tools.name: classroom_list_assignments
tools.description: Lists coursework assignments and due dates for a Google Classroom course.

tools.name: classroom_get_assignment
tools.description: Retrieves complete details and description for a specific Google Classroom assignment.

tools.name: classroom_list_announcements
tools.description: Lists instructor announcements and updates for a Google Classroom course.

tools.name: sys_get_time
tools.description: Gets exact local and UTC time, date, weekday, and timezone.

tools.name: excalidraw__create_diagram
tools.description: Generates an Excalidraw architecture diagram or mindmap with nodes and edges.

tools.name: excalidraw__create_flowchart
tools.description: Creates a top-down visual flowchart from sequential steps.

tools.name: excalidraw__list_diagrams
tools.description: Lists all saved Excalidraw diagram files in workspace/artifacts/.

tools.name: consult_memory
tools.description: Queries the central MemoryAgent for user preferences, machine details, system paths, or stored knowledge.
